name: DeepScanV1
preview: resolve exact source scope/folders and requested time/provider-position range
show existing coverage and unreadable/unknown portions
estimate messages/bytes/runtime only when adapter can do so without scanning content; unknown estimates remain unknown
show resource impact, retained-match review behavior and that external store remains read-only
bind preview_fingerprint to source scope revision, folder set, adapter version, range, current coverage fingerprint and config revision
authorization: every Deep Scan requires LLD-12 deliberate-action proof bound to action COMMUNICATION_DEEP_SCAN, source_scope_id, revision and preview_fingerprint
startup/scheduler/configuration/device/import/failure fallback can never synthesize or bypass this proof
execution: enqueue DEEP_SCAN durable job using exact preview scope
write historical coverage segments for committed readable work only; do not reset ordinary forward checkpoint
unknown/unreadable intervals remain warning/partial after success
